title: 六级方向 · 词汇辨析（自编）
subject: english
sourceNote: 同路自编练习，参考大学英语学习方向组织，非官方四级或六级真题，不承诺对应考试难度或分数。听力为合成朗读，非考试原音。答案与解析可离线查看。

questions.prompt: The new evidence may ___ the assumption that the method always works.
questions.explanation: undermine 表示削弱，新的证据削弱原有假设。undertake 承担，undergo 经历。

questions.prompt: The study found a ___ between sleep duration and attention, but did not prove causation.
questions.explanation: correlation 是相关性，与后面的 causation（因果关系）形成区别。研究发现相关不等于证明因果。

questions.prompt: The committee will ___ the proposal on Monday and announce its decision later.
questions.explanation: evaluate 表示评估提案。evacuate 撤离，evolve 演变，evaporate 蒸发。

questions.prompt: The policy aims to ___ the harmful effects of air pollution.
questions.explanation: mitigate 表示缓解负面影响。imitate 模仿，migrate 迁移，motivate 激励。

questions.prompt: The speaker gave a ___ account, covering only the most important points.
questions.explanation: 只涵盖最重要要点的说明是 concise（简洁的）。conscious 有意识的，considerable 相当大的。

questions.prompt: A single successful experiment does not ___ a general conclusion.
questions.explanation: justify 在此表示为一般结论提供充分依据。notify 通知，identify with 认同。

questions.prompt: The team chose a ___ approach, adapting the plan as new evidence appeared.
questions.explanation: 根据新证据调整计划体现 flexible（灵活的）。rigid 是僵化的，恰与语境相反。

questions.prompt: The report distinguishes ___ short-term costs and long-term benefits.
questions.explanation: distinguish between A and B 是区分两者的搭配。这里 A 为短期成本，B 为长期收益。

questions.prompt: The findings are ___ with earlier studies, which reported similar results.
questions.explanation: similar results 说明结果一致，用 consistent with。contrary to 表示与之相反。

questions.prompt: Participants were selected at random to reduce selection ___.
questions.explanation: selection bias 是选择偏差，随机选择参与者可以降低这一偏差。basis 是基础。

questions.prompt: The proposal is promising; ___, its cost has not yet been calculated.
questions.explanation: 前半句肯定方案，后半句指出成本尚未计算，是转折让步，用 nevertheless（然而）。

questions.prompt: The university will ___ more resources to student research next year.
questions.explanation: allocate resources to 表示向某用途分配资源。locate 定位，relocate 搬迁，associate 联系。
